title: Postdoctoral Position Open: AI/ML and Diabetes Research
bodyHtml:
A postdoctoral researcher position is available with the dkNET team at UCLA, focusing on developing and applying artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) methods to diabetes research. The role involves both independent and collaborative work, including building and integrating AI/ML tools, managing and supporting AI program activities, coordinating data workflows, and working with interdisciplinary research teams. Candidates should have a PhD in a relevant field, strong technical skills in AI/ML, project management experience, and good communication abilities. Experience in diabetes research or biomedical fields and experience in collaborative projects are preferred. The position is supervised by Prof. Wei Wang and is available immediately.

To learn more, read more at here.
summary: The dkNET team at UCLA, part of the NIDDK Information Network, is inviting applications for a postdoctoral researcher with strong expertise in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML). This position offers a unique opportunity to help advance diabetes research through the development and integration of cutting-edge AI/ML methodologies.
